purpose: Validate executable linkage of training-only source rows to generated model/reference artifacts to outcome-blind calibration and validation predictions, then one group gain per individual and external rank coverage.
context_fraction_distribution: one group-specific Bernoulli probability drawn uniformly from 0.1..0.9
training_weighting: within each stratum each biological group has equal weight 1, each group event receives 1 / group event count; finite pseudo-count 0.1 added per cell
source_serialization: deterministic JSON of exactly source training rows; SHA256 bound to generated model and reference artifact
feature_roster_schema: row_id, group_id, stratum, context (integer 0|1), weight optional; no outcome allowed
training_schema: row_id, group_id, stratum, context, outcome (one of four), weight optional
strict_source_to_forecast_checks: training-only fit recovers byte-identical model and reference
both holdout role forecasts derived only from exact model/reference artifacts
model predictions cannot be independently supplied
training source hashed and source-to-model replay checked
calibration outcomes inaccessible to validation scoring until frozen calibration
exact heldout outcomes per frozen row
design_for_shift: Same generated validation labels rotated by +2 modulo four for a separate adversarial shift test, with same model and calibration.
target: 90% one-sided group gain lower rank prediction for one new individual within the same stratum; rank floor((39+1)*0.1)=4.
guardrails: No early access to calibration/validation labels in model training
No empirical BOP raw GPS download or re-fit
Never treat 8-20 same-animal events as independent validation groups
No source content or IDs exported in public benchmark receipt
Contract/acceptance criteria not revised after first result to obtain positive classification
Failure and first result retained, no post-result tuning
